0022600103.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-1, 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (1-0, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West), who are riding a one-game winning streak. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and the teams have not met yet this season, after Sacramento lost all four matchups last season, most recently 122-110 in Portland on April 12.
